mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (title, description, status, priority, assignee, due_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{assignee}, #{dueDate}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, priority = #{priority}, assignee = #{assignee}, due_date = #{dueDate}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
